synth.notes:
Kick/slide token game, frame output. Arrows move the player 3px over floor colours {1,4}. If the destination overlaps blocks, those blocks are kicked and the player stays put. The kicked chain slides in 1px ticks over {1,4,15} and picks up any block it hits. It stops at any other colour or the portal bounds, at the player, or at a socket interior the block does not fit.
Click on a block: the player takes over its rect, and the old player stays drawn as an inert husk (rim 14, centre 4). Rendering: rim 14; block centre 5, player centre 0; every player edge touching a block is drawn 0. HUD row 63 shows ceil(n/2) zeros, counting every action. n is kept as hidden state only while the frame matches the last one returned; otherwise it falls back to n=2z-1 (0 when z=0).
Step-101 repair (not confirmed): once a sliding block's leading edge has crossed colour 15, the block stops after 9px more. This also fits the x=12 stop at step 63. The click-position hypothesis does not apply (action 1).
